sections.heading: Raipur's Industrial Base: Urla, Siltara and a Steel-Heavy Mix
paragraphs: Raipur's industry grew up north of the city in two estates run by the Chhattisgarh State Industrial Development Corporation. Urla, created around 1984-85 when the region was still part of Madhya Pradesh, was the first industrial area here, and Siltara followed in 1992-93 with the larger units. CSIDC lists both as industrial growth centres alongside Sirgitti and Tifra, and it runs a Metal Park, an Engineering Park and a Food Park, with BIS and CIPET offices in Raipur for testing and certification.

The mix is dominated by steel. The Urla Industries Association put 70 percent of its units in steel or steel-related products, an industry that began with re-rolling mills working scrap from the Bhilai steel plant and grew into sponge iron, structural and power businesses. Siltara's roads were upgraded under the Industrial Infrastructure Upgradation Scheme from 2007-08. Among the smaller Urla units are chemical makers such as a supplier of aluminium sulphate for water treatment at thermal power plants, and fabricators of wagon and mining components.

sections.heading: The 141.84-Acre Pharma Park at Naya Raipur
paragraphs: The new demand for hygienic tube in Raipur is planned rather than historic. The Naya Raipur Atal Nagar Development Authority has allotted 141.84 acres in Sector 22 of Naya Raipur to CSIDC for a pharmaceutical park, with research and development centres, testing laboratories, a flatted factory complex for ready industrial space and a common effluent treatment plant. The park is meant to host formulation and Ayush units as well as research and testing, and the state's investment portal lists it as a growth driver for the pharma and medical-device sector.

It is backed by Chhattisgarh's Industrial Development Policy 2024-30, which offers eligible pharmaceutical investments net SGST reimbursement for 12 years, interest subsidies, electricity-duty exemption and land concessions. The wider picture is a state spreading investment beyond its capital: the chief minister told Business Standard that about 33 percent of committed investment sits in the Raipur division, with the rest across Bilaspur, Durg, Surguja and Bastar, and that nine projects worth more than Rs 6,000 crore are already operational.

sections.heading: Where Electropolished Tube Fits in Raipur Today and in the Pharma Park Tomorrow
paragraphs: In Raipur's existing plants, electropolished 316L is a small-bore item. Steel and power units use it in boiler and steam-water sampling lines, analyser sample systems and chemical dosing lines, where a smooth passive bore stops trace contaminants sticking to the wall and keeps conductivity and silica readings honest. Food processing units, served by CSIDC's Food Park, use SF4 316L on product and CIP lines and SF1 304L or 316L on utilities.

The pharma park changes the scale. A formulation plant needs SF4 316L, mechanically polished then electropolished to ASME BPE surface designations, on purified water and WFI distribution, product transfer and CIP return, because the electropolished bore gives biofilm less to anchor in and resists rouging in hot water loops. An Ayush extraction unit needs the same finish on its extract and solvent lines. For acidic or chloride-bearing streams we quote 904L, which we supply electropolished, and for larger stainless headers ASTM A312 pipe in 304L or 316L.

sections.heading: Test Certificates for Raipur Plants and Contractors
paragraphs: Every heat we supply ships with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory. Each length is PMI tested before dispatch, so the grade on the certificate is the grade that reaches your site. Every electropolished lot has our internal Ra report, and our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

We supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube, and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L. If a power plant's inspection plan, a food auditor or a pharma consultant specifies extra tests, witness points or a marking format, state it in the enquiry so it is priced into the quotation.

sections.heading: Sending a Raipur RFQ
paragraphs: A complete enquiry gets a quotation from us within 24 hours. For plants in Urla, Siltara, the Food Park or the Naya Raipur pharma park, include:
bullets: The plant and service: steam-water sampling or analyser line at a steel or power unit, a food product or CIP line, a pharma purified water or WFI loop, or an Ayush extraction line, and your role as owner, contractor or skid builder.
Grade and finish per line: 316L electropolished instrument tube for sampling, SF4 316L for product contact and CIP, SF1 304L or 316L for utilities, 904L electropolished for aggressive chemistry.
Size, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A269 or A270 tube, A249 welded tube, A312 pipe.
Inspection or documentation requirements, and the delivery address in Raipur or Naya Raipur.

sections.heading: Supplying Raipur and Central Chhattisgarh
paragraphs: Material for Raipur leaves our Mumbai base at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004 by road, with every length capped and marked by heat number. The dispatch date and transit to your site are confirmed in writing on the quotation.
